meta.title: REDi FIT — find a trainer and book a session in the app
meta.description: REDi FIT connects you with trainers and sports specialists near you. Check their profile, pick a time and book a session in the app. Free for people who train.

hero.h1: Find a trainer, pick a time, book it in the app.
hero.sub: REDi FIT connects you with trainers and sports specialists near you. Find the right person, check their profile, pick a time that suits you and book a session – quickly and easily, all in one place.
hero.tagline_title: One app. Two ways to use it.
hero.tagline_text: For people looking for training and for trainers offering their services.
hero.switch_link: Are you a trainer? See what you get →
hero.screen_caption: App home screen: search and categories

dlaczego.h2: Don't waste time searching for trainers and arranging sessions
dlaczego.without_1: You browse different websites and social media profiles looking for the right trainer.
dlaczego.without_2: You check availability by sending messages or calling.
dlaczego.without_3: You compare trainers' prices and offers in different places.
dlaczego.without_4: You arrange the location and session details separately.
dlaczego.without_5: You have to agree on how to pay with the trainer.
dlaczego.with_1: You browse trainers' offers in one place – on a list or an interactive map.
dlaczego.with_2: You check free slots in the calendar and book a session.
dlaczego.with_3: You compare available services and prices before booking.
dlaczego.with_4: You see the location and session details right in the offer.
dlaczego.with_5: You choose an available payment method when booking.

kroki.lead: From choosing a trainer to booking a session – all conveniently in one app.
kroki.step_1_text: Choose the type of training, location and time. Browse trainers on a list or a map.
kroki.step_2_text: Learn about the trainer's experience and qualifications, read client reviews and check available services and prices.
kroki.step_3_text: Pick a convenient time and payment method. Manage your booking directly in the app.

kategorie.lead: Personal training, swimming, running, tennis, postnatal training and many other activities. Discover different ways to move and find a trainer who matches your needs, location and schedule.

gdzie.h2: Not just the gym. Train where you like!
gdzie.lead: Personal training doesn't have to mean going to the gym. On REDi FIT you'll find trainers who run sessions in training studios, outdoors or at your place. Choose the location and type of training that best fit your lifestyle.
gdzie.onsite_text: A gym, a park, a beach or another place chosen by the trainer. Check the location on the map before you book.
gdzie.mobile_text: Prefer to train at home or somewhere else convenient? Choose a trainer who travels to clients and check the area they cover.
gdzie.nearby_text: Use the “Nearby trainers” section on the app's home screen. Set your own search radius and discover trainers within the distance you choose.

wydarzenia.h2: More options, more reasons to move
wydarzenia.lead: Discover sports events, take advantage of discounted sessions and book free slots, even for today. REDi FIT gives you more ways to train whenever you have the time and feel like it.
wydarzenia.events_text: Discover group sessions, workshops and events organised by trainers. Check dates, locations, prices and available spots.
wydarzenia.happy_text: Take advantage of discounted prices at times set by trainers. Find great deals and train for a better price.
wydarzenia.today_text: Got a spare moment? Check sessions available the same day and book a convenient time in the app.
wydarzenia.favs_text: Save your favourite trainers to quickly return to their profiles, check available times and book your next sessions.
wydarzenia.screen_caption: App home screen: “Events” and “Train today” sections

opinie.h2: Read reviews before you choose a trainer
opinie.lead: On REDi FIT, reviews are written by clients after a completed session. That way you learn from people who have actually trained with a given trainer and can make an informed choice.

jezyki.lead: Use REDi FIT in the language you prefer. Set it when you first open the app and change it at any time in the settings.

sciezki.h2: One app. Two ways to use it.

meta.title: Redifit — how it works: find, check, book
meta.description: Three steps from finding a trainer to a booked session — with app screens and payment rules.

page_hero.h1: From search to a booked session
page_hero.lead: Three steps, all in the app. Below is each one with the screen it happens on, and the rules worth knowing before you pay.

znajdz.h2: Find a trainer by category, location and date
znajdz.lead: Pick a training category, type in an address and mark when you want to train. Results show up as a list or on a map.
znajdz.li: Free slots today — the "Train today" section on the home screen.
znajdz.li_2: Trainers near you — up to 15 km from your location, once location is on.
znajdz.li_3: Filters and map — narrow results by category, price and time of day (morning, afternoon, evening), and see how many trainers work in an area.
znajdz.li_4: Favourite trainers — save a trainer and come back from the home screen.
znajdz.caption: Ekran główny: kategorie, „Trenuj dziś”, trenerzy w okolicy
znajdz.caption_2: Wyszukiwarka: Kiedy? Gdzie? Cena, filtry kategorii, wyniki + widok mapy

sprawdz.caption: Profil trenera: zakładki Usługi / Opinie / Portfolio / Szczegóły
sprawdz.label: Space for a testimonial
sprawdz.body: [NEEDS: a real app user's review — name, role, city; not invented]
sprawdz.h2: Before you book, see who you are dealing with
sprawdz.lead: A trainer's profile shows what you need to decide: qualifications, specialisations, portfolio photos and client reviews.
sprawdz.li: Bio and qualifications — education, experience, completed courses and specialisations.
sprawdz.li_2: Portfolio — photos the trainer added to their profile.
sprawdz.li_3: Star-rated reviews — sort by newest, oldest, highest or lowest rated, mark a review as helpful or report it. Trainers can reply to reviews.
sprawdz.li_4: Services with prices — each service shows duration, price and location.
sprawdz.step_note: Reviews come from clients after a completed booking. [NEEDS: confirm with backend]

zarezerwuj.h2: Book and manage the session in one app
zarezerwuj.lead: Pick a time and payment method, then confirm. The booking lands in the app calendar, where you can change it, cancel it or add it to your phone calendar.
zarezerwuj.li: Card and BLIK in a secure Stripe form — the app does not store card details.
zarezerwuj.li_2: Cash or bank transfer — if the trainer offers them; the trainer sets the payment methods.
zarezerwuj.li_3: Booking calendar — tabs for upcoming, completed and cancelled; "Book again" in one tap.
zarezerwuj.li_4: The session in your phone — add it to your device calendar or save it as an .ics file.
zarezerwuj.li_5: Status notifications — push, email or SMS, your choice in settings.
zarezerwuj.title: Change and cancellation rules
zarezerwuj.text: Under the trainer's rules, a booking can be cancelled at least 24 hours in advance. A payment already taken may not be refunded. [NEEDS: confirm whether 24 h always applies]
zarezerwuj.caption: Podsumowanie rezerwacji z wyborem formy płatności (Gotówka / Karta / BLIK / Przelew)

bezpieczenstwo.h2: What's looking out for you when you pay in the app
bezpieczenstwo.lead: Five mechanisms that work before and after you book a session.
bezpieczenstwo.h3: Card details never touch the app
bezpieczenstwo.p: Card and BLIK are handled in Stripe's own form. Redifit doesn't store card numbers.
bezpieczenstwo.h3_2: Phone number confirmed by SMS code
bezpieczenstwo.p_2: You confirm your number with a code at registration, so accounts can't be opened on a random number.
bezpieczenstwo.p_3: A rating is left after a completed booking. An inappropriate review can be reported.
bezpieczenstwo.p_4: A trainer's event appears in the app after review. [NEEDS] the rules
bezpieczenstwo.p_5: The 24-hour condition and the possibility that the fee won't be refunded are on this page, not just in the terms.

t_profil.li: Bio and qualifications — profile name, specialisation, education, experience, completed courses and training.
t_profil.li_2: Portfolio — add photos from the camera or gallery and reorder them by dragging.

t_zasady.h2: You set services, prices and availability yourself
t_zasady.p: Name, description, category, duration, gross price and VAT rate.
t_zasady.p_2: On site with a map pin, or mobile with a range in kilometres.
t_zasady.p_3: Working hours, breaks, recurrence and a gap between bookings for travel or setup.
t_zasady.p_4: How far ahead clients can book, how much notice they need and until when they can reschedule.

t_popyt.h2: Four tools you use to drive bookings yourself
t_popyt.lead: All of them are in the app and need no extra advertising.
t_popyt.p: Lower the price at hours that are hard to fill. The discount runs on a cycle and expires on a day you set.
t_popyt.p_2: One slot, several participants. You set the level, price and spot limit, and add a gallery.
t_popyt.p_3: A message to everyone or to chosen people on your list, up to 200 characters, sent from your phone.
t_popyt.p_4: From a client's history, one button takes you back to the same service — for both sides.

faq_klient.needs_block: [NEEDS] pytania robocze, wywiedzione z aplikacji — zastąpić prawdziwymi pytaniami od użytkowników i supportu
faq_klient.summary: Do I need an account to book?
faq_klient.p: Yes. You create it in the app: email, first and last name, phone number and password, then confirm the number with an SMS code and accept the consents.
faq_klient.summary_2: How do I pay for a session?
faq_klient.p_2: The trainer sets the payment methods. You can pay by card or BLIK in the Stripe form, or — if the trainer offers it — in cash or by transfer.
faq_klient.p_3: Yes, in the app. Under the trainer's rules cancellation is possible at least 24 hours ahead, and a payment already taken may not be refunded.
faq_klient.summary_4: How do I know a trainer is credible?
faq_klient.p_4: Check the profile: education, completed courses, specialisations, portfolio and client reviews. Reviews are left by people after a completed booking.
faq_klient.summary_5: Can a trainer come to me?
faq_klient.p_5: Depends on the service. The trainer sets the location as in-person with a map pin, or mobile with a range in kilometres.
faq_klient.summary_6: What languages does the app support?
faq_klient.summary_7: Which phones does Redifit run on?
faq_klient.p_7: On Android and iOS. [NEEDS: minimum OS versions]
faq_klient.summary_8: Is Redifit the REDi FIT gym app?
faq_klient.p_8: Redifit is the app where clients book sessions with trainers. [NEEDS: clarify the relation to the REDi FIT gym]

faq_trener.summary: How much does a trainer account cost?
faq_trener.p: The REDi FIT Standard subscription costs PLN 100 per month. [NEEDS]
faq_trener.summary_2: How do I get paid for sessions paid online?
faq_trener.p_2: Online payments go to your Stripe payout account, which you connect in the app.
faq_trener.p_3: Yes, if you tick it. You set payment methods in the service settings: cash, card, BLIK, transfer.
faq_trener.summary_4: What if I am not running sessions for a while?
faq_trener.p_4: Add time off in the service settings: a date range and a note.
faq_trener.p_5: That is your call. You can allow rescheduling and set the minimum notice in hours.
faq_trener.summary_6: What happens if a subscription payment fails?
faq_trener.p_6: The app shows a "Payment failed" status and asks you to update the card. [NEEDS: effect on profile visibility]
